# Vulpkanin
## General Information
Vulpkanin have sharp claws, and their unarmed attacks deal [color=hotpink]Slash[/color] damage.
Their animal-like digestive system can process [color=lightgreen]raw meat[/color] and [color=lightgreen]blood[/color] without ill effects, but is [color=orchid]poisoned[/color] by [color=orchid]allicin[/color] (found in garlic and onions) and [color=orchid]theobromine[/color] (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
Their shape of their muzzle makes drinking difficult, and they tend to [color=palevioletred]spill whatever they're drinking[/color] on the ground.
They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less Cold damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]15% more Heat damage[/color] than most species. Their dense fur makes them prefer cooler temperatures than humans, and also makes them [color=#ffa500]extremely vulnerable to fire[/color].
## Leaping
Vulpkanins' digitigrade legs allow them to [color=lightgreen]leap impressive distances[/color]. This is useful for [color=lightgreen]jumping over ground-based hazards[/color] (such as bottomless chasms), or for a [color=lightgreen]quick burst of speed[/color] to escape a dangerous situation or chase someone down.
Be careful not to [color=palevioletred]crash into anything mid-leap[/color], or you'll fall to the ground and [color=palevioletred]drop what you're holding[/color]!
